title: lathyrus luteus subsp. ochraceus
intro: Lathyrus luteus subsp. ochraceus, commonly known as the yellow pea or golden pea, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and improve cardiovascular health due to its high levels of fiber and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus luteus subsp. ochraceus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, saponins, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
